verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes its own API reference with per-endpoint pages (send-calls, create-api-key) and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json, so a structured, spec-backed reference clearly exists. The evidence never shows that this reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in place, which is the core of this story. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable request examples in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
